description: Implementation of the QhullFacet class, representing facets in Qhull's computational geometry structures, including methods for retrieving geometric properties, printing, and managing facet relationships.

classes.name: QhullFacet
classes.description: Represents a facet in Qhull's geometric structure, providing methods for accessing geometric properties, relationships, and printing information.

methods.name: getCenter
methods.description: Returns the Voronoi center or facet centroid based on the print format and Qhull options.

methods.name: innerplane
methods.description: Returns the inner hyperplane of the facet, adjusted below the vertices.

methods.name: nextFacet2d
methods.description: Returns the next 2D facet in the sequence, updating the provided vertex.

methods.name: outerplane
methods.description: Returns the outer hyperplane of the facet, above all points.

methods.name: tricoplanarOwner
methods.description: Returns the owner facet if the facet is tricoplanar; throws error if area has been computed previously.

methods.name: voronoiVertex
methods.description: Returns the Voronoi vertex associated with the facet, requiring specific Qhull options.

methods.name: facetArea
methods.description: Calculates and returns the area of the facet.

methods.name: coplanarPoints
methods.description: Returns the set of coplanar points associated with the facet.

methods.name: neighborFacets
methods.description: Returns the set of neighboring facets.

methods.name: outsidePoints
methods.description: Returns the set of points outside the facet.

methods.name: ridges
methods.description: Returns the set of ridges of the facet.

methods.name: vertices
methods.description: Returns the set of vertices of the facet.
